query: SELECT character.id, world_gm.agent_id, "group".branch_id FROM world_member AS member JOIN player_character ON player_character.member_id = member.id JOIN character ON character.id = player_character.character_id JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = character.id JOIN "group" ON "group".id = character_group.group_id JOIN world_gm ON world_gm.world_id = "group".world_id WHERE member.id = ? AND member.world_id = ? AND member.user_id = ? AND member.access = 'active' AND player_character.character_id = ? AND player_character.agent_id = ?
